verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents a Create Adjustment Journal Entry API endpoint that takes an account_uuid plus debit or credit amounts. Its accounting page says accountants can update journal entries, and a Manual Journal Entry report exists, so manual entries are directly supported. However, nothing shows that debits must equal credits, and no memo or description field is mentioned. Missing for 10: documented balanced debit/credit validation, supporting memo/description fields on entries, UI-level posting workflow detail, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos

citations.quote: New entries must include the account_uuid, and the debit or credit amounts
Your accountant will be able to update your journal entries and chart of accounts, giving you the most accurate view of your financial health.
